latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Clip Generator.

- Instantly generate 1080p video clips from text prompts or uploaded images, ready to download in MP4 and other formats.
- Seamless workflow: connect, upload, describe your video, and receive a downloadable clip in 30–90 seconds.
- Automatic token/session management and free credit system built-in for easy usage.
- Smart command handling: supports exports, credit checks, upload, and timeline editing via simple chat commands.
- Cloud GPU rendering with direct export and support for multiple popular video/audio/image formats.
- Clear error messaging and user guidance for smooth end-to-end video creation.
